Commentary.Commentary: So, that is it from this game! All to play for in the 5th T20I then. That is on the 3rd of this month and it begins at 1400 local (1800 GMT). Till then, good bye and take care!

Kieron Pollard says you need to come hard in games like this, it was a must-win game, he did not play a lot and he wanted to give himself time and it went well. Mentions they were right into the game after the first innings, they wanted to get out of the first 6 without any damage with the ball and Gayle got that important wicket which set the tone. Also tells he hopes they can make one more push in the final game. Ends by saying Bravo is exceptional and he continues to do well time and time again.

Temba Bavuma says it was not bad luck, looking at their bowling, they bowled well majority but they did not bowl well towards the end and that is what put them under pressure. Adds they were terrific in the middle overs, Shamsi and Linde were very good and they thought they would restrict them under 150 but they were poor in the death. States the surface plays a big part and Shamsi has been brilliant, Linde has also been good. Also tells, they can't use the last few overs as an excuse, the batting was disappointing, except for de Kock no one put up a fight.

For South Africa, chasing a competitive total, they needed partnerships but that was not the case. Also, they needed a couple of batters to play well but except for de Kock no other batter showed fight. Overall, it was a poor effort with the bat by the visitors.

They did not let the visitors build partnerships and kept picking wickets when mattered. Gayle was the one who started things off but it was McCoy, Bravo, Pollard and Russell who were very good. They bowled through the middle overs, built the pressure by squeezing the runs and due to that got wickets. Bravo was the pick out of them as he finished with career-best figures of 4-19.

We have a decider then! What a clinical performance with the ball by the Windies! Despite losing Allen, who is so vital for them with the ball, they have defended this quite nicely. Credit though has to be given to their skipper, that knock from him has to be the difference between the two sides. It is because of him they finished over 160 and that was always going to be difficult to chase especially if the bowlers picked up wickets on regular basis and that is what the Windies did.
Flatter, on middle. Rabada lifts it over bowler's head for a single towards long off. West Indies win by 21 runs and they level the series 2-2.
Another tossed up, on off, this is pushed to covers for a single.
Outside off, driven to the off side for a single.
FOUR! Some more consolation runs for Rabada. On middle. Rabada lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on middle. Nortje pushes it down to long on for a single.
On middle. Anrich Nortje misses his cut.
So 30 runs needed off the last over! Full ball, on the pads. Rabada misses his heave.
SIX! Banged away! A slower, full ball, on middle. Rabada stans tall and lofts it over long on for a biggie.
Outside off, driven on the off side for a single.
Outside off. Left alone.
A back of a length ball, on middle, pulled away to mid-wicket for a single.
Just a single of the free hit as this is worked towards off side for another single.
NO BALL! Above waist full toss, on middle. Rabada ducks under it, but somehow manages to get some bat on it, on the off side for single. Free-Hit coming up.

OUT! CAUGHT! Dwayne Bravo gets his 4th wicket and what an exceptional spell it has been from him! South Africa are 9 down now and looks like the game is already done and dusted! A slower fuller delivery, on middle. Ngidi heaves it, not off the middle, in the air, towards mid-wicket where Lendl Simmons takes another spectacular catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Lendl Simmons b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: Beautiful delivery by Bravo! A low dipping full toss, on middle. Ngidi misses to read it, but jams it out in time.
On middle. Pushed to covers for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! South Africa now 8 down and Shamsi departs for a duck! A slower length delivery, outside off. Shamsi swings at it, gets a thick outside edge, in the air, straight to Chris Gayle at point region.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Gayle b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: On middle. Blocked out.

OUT! CAUGHT! This might be the game for the windies as they take the huge wicket of Quinton de Kock. He was the only hope of the proteas. A low full toss, way outside off. Quinton de Kock stretches for the slash but hits it straight in the hands of Lendl Simmons at point.
Commentary.Howout: c Lendl Simmons b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off. Quinton de Kock plays it on the off side and retains the strike. 42 needed of 18 balls.
FOUR! Need more of this from Quinton de Kock! Angles a length ball, down the leg side. de Kock pulls it past short fine leg for a boundary.
BYE! Another slower length ball, outside off. Rabada swings and misses. The keeper fumbles to carry and the batters take a bye,
Two dots in a row! Another slower delivery, outside off. Rabada swings and misses.
SWING AND A MISS! A slower, length ball, just around 4th stump, Rabada swings and misses.
A length ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock rocks back and chops it to sweeper cover for another single.
Just a single to end the over! Yorker, outside off, this is jammed out to point for  a single.
Rabada is off the mark as this is pushed to covers for one run.
Another fuller length ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock drives it to long off for a single.
SIX! Banged! Consecutive 50's for Quinton de Kock! A fuller ball, on middle. de Kock arcks back and heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Can he take his team over the line?

OUT! CAUGHT! Another slower ball by Bravo does the trick! And South Africa are 6 down! A slower length ball, outside off. Linde swings hard but gets a thick outside edge, in the air and straight to Lendl Simmons at point, who takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Lendl Simmons b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: A slower length ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock slahses it to covers, just for one.
A single to end! On middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Third boundary in the over and de Kock is not going down without a fight! 60 in 31! This is short and on the body, this is pulled, not off the middle but in the gap between deep square leg and fine leg for a boundary.
Really full again and on middle, de Kock looks to heave it on the leg side but he gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Up and over! Second boundary in the over! Picked his spot well! Edwards goes full and on middle, this is lofted over mid off and it races away to the fence.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed out towards cover for one.
FOUR! A full toss and put away! Outside off, this is hit through covers for a boundary.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed out on the off side for one.

Excellent from Simmons! A yorker outside off, this is jammed out to point who is quite close in. Simmons has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. De Kock had to dive to make it back in. Could have been close.
A short one, Linde evades it. Good sharp bumper to welcome the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! Six and then out! Russell gets his revenge and with Miller gone, this looks a task out of reach for South Africa despite de Kock still being there. Good delivery, very full and outside off. Miller fails to get the elevation he wanted as this is quite full and he hits it straight to covers where Gayle takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Gayle b Andre Russell

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Just wide! That is a lovely effort but that is a much-needed biggie from Miller! The visitors will hope this breaks the shackles! On middle, Miller whips it towards the mid-wicket fence. Walsh, the sub, in the deep, runs to his right, dives but it goes wide.
A low full toss outside off, this is hit through covers but only one. Singles won't hurt the Windies.
De Kock looks to play the paddle scoop but this is very full on the pads. He misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. One leg bye! End of a brilliant spell by Pollard.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Two taken! On middle, this is worked wide of long on. Two taken.
On the pads, de Kock looks to whip it but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. One taken. Leg bye!
In the gap but only two! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard, Hetmyer at deep square leg, runs to his right and keeps it down to two.
On middle, this is worked on the leg side for one.
Both the batters are finding it difficult to get any bat on the ball. Another full ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock misses his drive.
Just a single! On a length, outside off, this is driven to covers for a single.
SWING AND A MISS! Another yorker length delivery, outside off. Miller misses his drive.
Outside off, on a length. Miller steers it down but finds the fielder at short third man.
On the pads, this is flicked to mid-wicket for another single.
A fuller delivery, way outside off. Quinton de Kock looks for an expansive drive but misses. Nicholas Pooran behind optimistically appeals for caught behind, but the umpire is unmoved.
Slower ball, on the pads. Quinton de Kock flicks it to square leg and retains the strike. 91 needed in 54 balls now. South Africa need big overs from now on.
On a length, outside off. Miller pushes it to the off side and gets off the mark with a single.
David Miller walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Rassie van der Dussen departs early and South Africa are four wickets down! Outside off, on a length. Rassie van der Dussen looks to cut from his crease, but gets a thick outside edge, straight to the keeper. Pollard did it with the bat and now doing it with the ball.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Kieron Pollard

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR BYES! A slower length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen misses his slash, the ball goes to the keeper on the bounce, who fails to grab it and it runs away to the fence. These are bonus runs amd ,much-needed for the visitors.
Another length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to sweeper cover and collects a brace.
Outside off, this is pushed to covers.
Again on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen flickes it to fine leg for another single. 99 runs needed of 60 balls.
On the pads, flicked wide of square leg for brace.
On middle, de Kock works it to long off. Bravo scores a direct hit on the bowler's end, but de Kock was well in.
Ask for two and gets it! Another length ball, outside off, Quinton de Kock chops it wide of third man and takes an easy couple.
A back of  alength ball, on hips, flicked to square leg for a single. Rassie van der Dussen is off the mark.
Rassie walks out to bat!

OUT! TIMBER! The pressure paid got to the right-hander and Aiden Markram walks back! A fuller ball, around off. Markram makes room for himself and looks to cut it but gets beaten for the pace and the ball hits the off stump. Windies on top.
A dot to end! So once again South Africa fail to capitalize after getting a boundary early in the over. Outside off, this is slapped to covers.
Another single! Full and outside off, it is hit through covers for one.
Short and otusde off, this is cut but to point.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket. De Kock calls for two early but has to settle for one.
Just the one! This time Pollard moves the cover back. It is hit through that region for one.
FOUR! Slammed! That helps a lot! Boundary early in the over. Outside off and on a length. This is crunched through covers for a boundary.
That is cleverly bowled! Sees de Kock shape up for the reverse sweep so bowls a very slow ball, full and outside off. De Kock swings but misses. So despite the boundary, only 5 from the over.
A yorker outside off, de Kock fails to jam it out.
Sliced away! Outside off, Markram swings, it goes off the outer half towards point for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time and it is a welcome boundary! Much-needed! A full toss on middle, this is heaved wide of long on.
Yet another dot! This will only increase the pressure! On middle, this is whipped towards mid-wicket.
From around the wicket, this is full and on middle, Markram jams it out to covers.
Just a single to end! Outside off, it is hit through covers for one.
Just the one again! On off, this is played down to long on for one.
Outside off, this one stays a touch low. Markram chops it on the off side for one. Boundaries hard to come by at the moment.

Wrong end! On middle, de Kock works it through mid-wicket. They take one, de Kock wants two and takes off but is sent back. Pollard himself goes after it but fires it towards the keeper which is the wrong end.
On off, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Two to begin! Pollard bowls it full and outside off, it is lifted over covers. Lewis runs to his right, slides and saves two for his side.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one. A superb over by Bravo and Windies will be quite pleased with where they are in the game right now. South Africa are 43 for 2 after 6.
Bravo gets away with one there! A full toss on the pads, Markram works it but finds short fine leg. A little to that fielder's left or right and it would have been a certain boundary.
Outside off, this is carved down towards deep point for one.
A slower one, fuller and on off, it is pushed towards cover for one.
Another dot! Bravo goes wide of the crease and bowls a yorker on middle, it is jammed out nicely.
On middle, Markram works it to mid-wicket.
Bravo is on now! He will bowl the last over of the Powerplay!
Outside off, on a length. Markram pushes it on the off side for a single. 8 runs and a wicket coming off this over.
Full ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock on drives it to mid on who runs across and fumbles to stop it, single taken.
On middle. Kept out.
Markram is off the mark! On a length, on the pads, this is flicked to mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Length ball, way outside off, over the tramline. Wide called.
Aiden Markram is the new man in!

OUT! LBW! Temba Bavuma walks back and the Proteas are two down inside the powerplay! They lose their captain as well just for 7 runs! A low dipping full toss, around middle and leg. Temba Bavuma looks to paddle scoop it but misses it, gets hit on the pads. West Indies appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Bavuma has a chat with de Kock but they opt not to take the review.
This is not good! Allen is seen holding his shoulder! Not good at all as his 4 overs could be crucial. He is walking back now, not good signs.

FOUR! Length ball, outside off. Bavuma drags it across the line and pulls it through mid-wicket. Fabian Allen chases the ball, dives and flicks but lobs it over the ropes, looks like he has damaged his right hand in the process as well.

DROPPED! Hard chance but the windies have to take this wickets! A pacy short ball, on middle. Bavuma is too early to his pull shot, pulls it towards short mid-wicket, where Chris Gayle runs back and stretches his right arm but fails to carry it.
A length ball, outside off, hits the deck and seams away. Bavuma hops and looks to defend but gets outer half of his blade towards the point fielder.
Length ball, outside off. Bavuma punches it to covers.
Just short! A fuller delivery, outside off. Quinton de Kock checks his shot and drives it just short of mid on fielder, single taken.
WIDE! Pressure straight on Russell, as this is spilled way outside off. Wide called.
FOUR! 10 coming of the first two deliveries! Another fuller ball, outside off. de Kock gets low and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Russell is on now!
SIX! Welcomes Andre Russell with a biggie! A fuller delivery, around off. Quinton de Kock rocks back and lofts it over long off for a biggie.
On middle, this is flicked to square leg for another single. 8 runs off this over.

Another fuller delivery, outside off. Bavuma plays it to point and scampers for a run, the fielder at point has a shy at bowler's end, but gets hit on Bavma's diving bat, they deny to take run off it.
Fuller, on middle, this is flicked to square leg for a single.
Angling in on a length, on the pads. Quinton de Kock misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! A short ball, way outside off, this is slashed over point for a boundary.
WIDE! Spills it way down the leg side, Quinton de Kock misses his flick. Wide given
Fuller and on middle, this is driven to mid off.
On middle, this is worked towards mid on for one. An exceptional first over by Gayle comes to an end.
Bavuma is off the mark as this is pushed down to long on. Can Gayle end this over well?
Yet another dot! On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Bavuma looks to sweep but misses.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
DROPPED? There was a sound. Shorter and outside off, extra bounce on that one. Bavuma looks to cut but misses.

OUT! Hendricks has nothing behind the line and Gayle strikes! What a move to bring him on. A complete masterstroke as he strikes on his first ball. This is fired full and outside off. Hendricks looks to drive but misses. He seems to have dragged his foot out. The keeper whips the bails off and is celebrating. It is taken upstairs. Replays show that Reeza has to take the long walk back. Early wicket for the Windies, ideal start for them.
Commentary.Howout: st Nicholas Pooran b Chris Gayle

Commentary.Commentary: Has Gayle struck on the first ball? Well, the keeper is very confident, what a masterstroke this will be if he does. Stumping appeal taken upstairs.
Chris Gayle is on now! That's a surprise, the big man is bowling after a long time.
FOUR! First boundary of the chase! A full toss, on middle, near waist high! Quinton de Kock whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
NOT OUT! Hendricks is in! On middle, this is played towards mid on. They go for one. Bravo there hits the stumps again at the bowler's end. It is taken upstairs and replays show that Hedricks is in.
Run out appeal and it is referred! Hendricks seems in!
LEG BYE! On the pads, de Kock misses his flick, takes a leg bye off the pads to the leg side.
Reeza Hendricks is off the mark! On a length, on middle, this is flicked to square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Hendricks looks to drive but misses.

OVERTHROW! Starts with a full toss, on middle. Quinton de Kock pushes it to covers, where Dwayne Bravo scores a direct hit at the striker's end, the ball ricochets and goes to the leg side for a single. South Africa and Quinton de Kock are underway.
